actual_scope: For the pinned helper-462 matcher, exhibit a zero-swap word with exactly one scale of coefficient -16 and strictly fewer than 53 shears, or prove a lower bound under those hypotheses. The witness has 29 shears. That length is the minimum of one finite column-ordered repair family. Every such word has at least 8 shears because rank(D^{-1} S - I) = 8. No claim that 29 is minimal outside the family, no P2 bill, and no new kappa.
scope_change_reason: Handoff comment 19137812 asks for one literal stock/role/route generator. Merged PR #6954 already gives a 0-swap 1-scale 53-shear word and leaves the shear minimum open. This package answers only that length question for the same pinned matcher and the same one scale of coefficient -16. It does not audit #5717/#5719, price inherited P2 tariffs, or search words with two or more scales.
bottleneck_link: The route ledger is one charged part of the missing physical generator. The merged one-scale word used 53 shears. A one-shear pivot repair produces an explicit 29-shear word with the same scale by -16, so a later generator cannot treat 53 as the one-scale length. The rank bound shows at least 8 shears. Neither number is a tariff or a new kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the explicit 29-shear word, the finite census of the column-ordered repair family, the scale-position lemma, and the rank lower bound of 8. Do not search every rational word of length at most 28, price P2 tariffs, or change the selected frontier.
evidence: Exact rational product of the frozen 0-swap, 1-scale, 29-shear word equals the pinned matcher, and so does the elementary-matrix product. The merged elimination on the same det-1 matrix still has 53 shears (15 exchange, 28 balanced, 4 clear, 6 back). The canonical repair uses 6 normalizations, 10 clears and 13 back-substitutions. The exhaustive repair-family census has minimum 29 for every scale row except row 2, where it is 30. Moving the scale to the front or after 10 shears keeps 29 shears and the same product. rank(D^{-1} S - I) = 8 for every scale row.

open_questions.question: Is there a zero-swap word with exactly one scale of coefficient -16 and fewer than 29 shears?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Twenty-nine is the minimum of the column-ordered repair family and an upper bound on the shear count. The rank bound is 8, so the integers 9 through 28 remain open.
open_questions.first_step: Keep one scale of coefficient -16 and build one word outside column order 0..7. When a column's only nonzero entry is not 1, import a unit pivot into a row that is currently zero there, and count the shears needed to sort a residual permutation.
open_questions.blocked_by: Rational shear coefficients make the set of words of length at most 28 infinite. This census does not range outside its elimination family.

open_questions.question: Can the rank lower bound of 8 be raised for a zero-swap one-scale word on this matcher?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Subadditivity of rank(W - I) is proved and equals 8 on every D^{-1} S, so it does not decide whether 29 is minimal.
open_questions.first_step: Find an invariant that grows by less than the shear count on the 29-shear word and by at least 1 on every non-identity elementary shear, then evaluate it on D^{-1} S.
open_questions.blocked_by: A single shear may carry any nonzero rational coefficient, so denominator size alone does not force more than one shear.
